name: Question 5
problem: Given the function $f(x,y,z)=6{x}^{2}-y+{z}^{3}$, find the equation of the tangent plane to the level surface that passes  through the point where $(x,y,z)=(\frac{1}{2},3,2).$
worked_solution:
The equation of the tangent plane to the level surface $f(x,y,z)=k$ at the point $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})$ can be expressed as

$$
∇f({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})\cdot ⟨x-{x}_{0},\,y-{y}_{0},\,z-{z}_{0}⟩=0.
$$

First, we find the gradient of $f(x,y,z)$ and evaluate it at $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})=(\frac{1}{2},3,2):$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\,f(x,y,z) & ={f}_{x}(x,y,z)\,i+{f}_{y}(x,y,z)\,j+{f}_{z}(x,y,z)\,k \\  & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(6{x}^{2}-y+{z}^{3})\text{ }i+\frac{∂}{∂y}(6{x}^{2}-y+{z}^{3})\text{ }j+\frac{∂}{∂z}(6{x}^{2}-y+{z}^{3})\text{ }k \\  & =12x\text{ }i-\text{ }j+3{z}^{2}k \\ ∇\,f(\frac{1}{2},3,2) & =12\cdot \frac{1}{2}\text{ }i-\text{ }j+3(2)^{2}k \\  & =6\,i-\,j+12k \\  & =⟨6,-1,12⟩\end{aligned}
$$

We can now write down the Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the level surface, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})\cdot ⟨x-{x}_{0},\,y-{y}_{0},\,z-{z}_{0}⟩ & =0 \\ ∇f(\frac{1}{2},3,2)\cdot ⟨x-\frac{1}{2},\,y-3,\,z-2⟩ & =0 \\ ⟨6,-1,12⟩\cdot ⟨x-\frac{1}{2},\,y-3,\,z-2⟩ & =0 \\ 6(x-\frac{1}{2})-(y-3)+12(z-2) & =0 \\ 6x-y+12z-24 & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Question 5
?

Given the function f(x,y,z)=6x2−y+z3, find the equation of the tangent plane to the level surface that passes through the point where (x,y,z)=(12,3,2).

a
 3x−2y−5z+11=0
b
 6x−y+12z−24=0
c
 6x−3y−4z+24=0
d
 6x−y+z+12=0
e
 2x−y−4z+13=0
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The equation of the tangent plane to the level surface f(x,y,z)=k at the point (x0,y0,z0) can be expressed as

∇f(x0,y0,z0)⋅⟨x−x0,y−y0,z−z0⟩=0.

First, we find the gradient of f(x,y,z) and evaluate it at (x0,y0,z0)=(12,3,2):

∇f(x,y,z)=fx(x,y,z)i+fy(x,y,z)j+fz(x,y,z)k=∂∂x(6x2−y+z3) i+∂∂y(6x2−y+z3) j+∂∂z(6x2−y+z3) k=12x i− j+3z2k∇f(12,3,2)=12⋅12 i− j+3(2)2k=6i−j+12k=⟨6,−1,12⟩

We can now write down the Cartesian equation of the tangent plane to the level surface, as follows:

∇f(x0,y0,z0)⋅⟨x−x0,y−y0,z−z0⟩=0∇f(12,3,2)⋅⟨x−12,y−3,z−2⟩=0⟨6,−1,12⟩⋅⟨x−12,y−3,z−2⟩=06(x−12)−(y−3)+12(z−2)=06x−y+12z−24=0
